# SCRUTINY Lens

> Desktop analyst tool for exploring Common Criteria security certificates as interactive graphs, powered by the SCRUTINY Fabric protocol (Nostr overlay). AI-interpreted view-models with quote-verified provenance; deterministic protocol layer via @scrutiny-fabric/core.

## Onboarding

- [**Session Bootstrap**](docs/session-bootstrap.md): READ FIRST in fresh sessions — handoff brief (decision register, open threads, owner working rules, read order, starter moves)

## Specification

- [PRD](docs/prd.md): goals, non-goals, success criteria, niche profiles
- [Journeys](docs/journeys.md): J1 search → J2 graph → J3 chat → J4 detail/audit → J5 sessions; mermaid sequence diagrams + acceptance criteria per journey
- [View Models](docs/view-models.md): complete zod schema catalog (11 VMs) with field tables, provenance rules, icon enum, examples per VM — the generative-UI contract
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): module map (mermaid), data flow, invariants I1-I8, ADR log ADR-001..013
- [Component Registry](docs/component-registry.md): VM.kind → Svelte component mapping; IconToken → Lucide map; component file structure
- [Types](docs/types.md): canonical shared types (NostrEvent, GraphView, Session, SearchFilter, Citation, VMKind)
- [Profiles](docs/profiles.md): DomainProfile schema; shared CC-vocab appendix; smartcard / certificate / generic built-ins
- [Verification](docs/verification.md): fixture, Docker, skeleton→fill, citation-registry, vm_cache DDL, empty-first-run contracts
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md): protocol + app vocabulary (spec v0.8.0 refs)
- [API](docs/api.md): /api/ai/* route contracts with request/response schemas and error envelopes
- [Build Rules](AGENTS.md): hard rules for agents (runes, no NDK, DOMPurify, zod-at-boundary, real streaming, registry-only kind selection)

## Key constraints

- AI chooses semantics, never presentation (IconToken/TypeToken enums → deterministic visual maps)
- Every AI-filled field is quote-verified against source event content
- Degradation is honest and visible; the app must not fabricate when the LLM is down
- Edges are protocol bindings from @scrutiny-fabric/core resolve/admit — never AI-inferred
